decisions.reason: Minimum quantity lubrication systems fit a German machinery firm's metalworking coolant and lubrication portfolio, demand from sustainability and dry-machining trends is steady, and missing archived pages after 2019 are not evidence of withdrawal.

Hydrocyclone coolant filters are long-lived industrial products that complement the firm's filtration line and earn recurring spare-part and service revenue, so dropping one within three years would be unusual.
Gravity band filters are a standard part of a coolant filtration range, cheap to keep offering, and core to the firm's machine-tool customer base.
